text:
maya: quick sync — ran AWQ micro-batch profiling on A100 private cluster this morning. latency looks promising but saw a small quality delta on NQ. sharing raw numbers.

alex: can you paste the numbers and the eval size? which NQ split?

maya: NQ dev, ~2k queries. summary:
```
model         | p95 lat (ms) | mrr   | delta_mrr
fp16 baseline | 142          | 0.721 | 0.00
awq-int8      | 118          | 0.711 | -0.010 (-1.39%)
awq-fp8       | 125          | 0.715 | -0.006 (-0.83%)
gptq-int8     | 120          | 0.713 | -0.008 (-1.11%)
```
latency wins ~15-20% p95 vs fp16, cost estimate ~20% lower. p-value on mrr diff ~0.02 (paired bootstrap).

sam: ok helpful. 2k is decent. i'd want golden set checks + hallucination / safety suite run. what's the distribution of seq len? micro-batching helped more on longer seqs?

maya: seq len median 256, 90th ~1024. micro-batch yields most benefit for >512. ran golden set (200 prompts) — awq-int8 MRR delta -0.9% vs fp16, hallucination count no obvious spike (within noise).

jordan: cost win is nice but product needs stability. propose rollout corridor: hosted canary 1% traffic, dedicated 5% (burst to 10% if metrics stable), private opt-in up to 20% for customers that choose the variant. fallback rules needed.

eva: add a safety gate: run golden set every 15m during canary. rollback if MRR delta worse than -0.5% over 30m on the golden set, OR if hallucination rate increases >0.2% absolute. also require semantic-eval on 3 critical intents (auth, payments, content-filter) to be within -0.4%.

sam: agree. also add perf guard: rollback if p95 latency degrades beyond +15% of baseline or user-visible errors increase >0.05%.

alex: infra notes — ensure we have a fallback variant artifact (model: fp16-latest) pinned and healthcheck endpoint that returns both perf and eval metrics. if variant fails health check, traffic automatically reroutes to fp16 on same host pool. implement canary traffic shift in increments: 0->1->3->5 (every 30m) for hosted; dedicated use 5->10->20 (hrly).

maya: here's the eval command i used:
```
rdw-eval --model awq-int8 --suite nq-dev.json --golden golden_200.json --metrics mrr,em,hallucination --samples 2000
```
will add the semantic intent set next.

jordan: how do we plan to capture per-customer regressions in private deploys? need alerting on per-tenant golden failures.

maya: plan: ship telemetry hooks to private agent to publish aggregated golden-set deltas + optional raw failing examples (customer opt-in). add per-tenant guard that disables variant if any tenant sees >1% absolute MRR drop on their golden set.

eva: request: include a preflight check in the rollout playbook to run AWQ artifact through the safety eval and a short hallucination probe before any traffic.

sam: final gating thresholds proposal (canary -> to config):
- golden MRR delta <= -0.5% (fail)
- semantic intents delta <= -0.4%
- hallucination delta <= +0.2% absolute
- p95 latency <= +15%
- error rate delta <= +0.05%
- auto-fallback to fp16 if any triggered for >15m

maya: sounds good. i'll draft the rollout config and a small smoke script to run the preflight and continuous golden checks. i'll also run a short hosted canary tomorrow and post the telemetry.

deploy-bot: canary job created: job_id=canary-2032104567-01, targets=hosted-1%, dedicated-5% (pending maya rollout-doc)

maya: thanks — will @alex and @sam when doc is ready. aiming to start 12:30 UTC tomorrow.
